commands.name: schema
commands.summary: Print command metadata. Windows UIA retains AX role/action names for compatibility.

commands.name: request-permission
commands.summary: Windows UI Automation needs no macOS permission. Elevated and secure desktops remain inaccessible.

commands.name: apps
commands.summary: List visible GUI applications and PIDs.

commands.name: activate
commands.summary: Bring an application to the foreground and verify it.

commands.name: open
commands.summary: Open an HTTP, HTTPS or Slack URL.

commands.name: tree
commands.summary: Read a bounded live accessibility tree.

commands.name: show
commands.summary: Print a readable live outline with paths.

commands.name: find
commands.usage: blindly4 find [--title TEXT] [--role ROLE] [--value TEXT] [--description TEXT] [--pid PID] [--depth N] [--limit N]
commands.summary: Search current accessible properties.

commands.name: focused
commands.summary: Read the focused control without changing focus.

commands.name: inspect
commands.summary: Inspect one live element.

commands.name: actions
commands.summary: List supported actions.

commands.name: focus
commands.summary: Focus an element.

commands.name: show-menu
commands.summary: Expand an accessible menu control when supported.

commands.name: scroll-to
commands.summary: Scroll an accessible item into view.

commands.name: press
commands.usage: blindly4 press --path INDEX[.INDEX...] [--pid PID] [--expect-description TEXT] [--require-selected] [--require-value-path PATH --require-value TEXT]
commands.summary: Invoke or select a control; may submit external data.

commands.name: set-value
commands.summary: Set a writable ValuePattern.

commands.name: set-selected-text
commands.summary: Replace selected text in a focused writable control.

commands.name: click
commands.summary: Click a screen coordinate in the verified target application.

commands.name: type
commands.summary: Inject Unicode text into the foreground application.

commands.name: paste
commands.summary: Paste, optionally verifying an exact writable target draft.

commands.name: scroll
commands.summary: Inject bounded wheel input into the foreground application.

commands.name: key
commands.usage: blindly4 key --key KEY [--pid PID] [--target-path PATH --require-value TEXT]
commands.summary: Inject a key; a guarded key requires exact focused draft and PID.
